notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 Notes!
notes.content:
Enjoying Co-op? Got some quick changes relating to that. 

Also, this game is now Steam Remote Play Together compatible! There'll probably be a decent amount of input lag (promise it's not there during local co-op), but it's a very quick and convenient way to try out co-op with other people!

////FIXES////////////////////////////////////
- SFX spam from throwing Player 2 as Acro will no longer happen
- Added in minor unit collision between players

notes.title: Patch 1.0.10 Notes!
notes.content:
The controller system inside of the game has been updated, so you'll have to redo your custom controls! Sorry for the inconvenience, but this will lead to the eventual cooperative play update, so I figured I send this patch out now so that as many people can make new keybinds before the coop update!

Alongside some other minor fixes.

////FIXES///////////////////////////////////
- Restored tilesets in the final stage's room right before the fight
- Fixed Velvet Ridge's stage displaying a gold medal for a 2:05 time even though the best time displays 2:00 (it should be 2:00 for gold medal)
- Fixed a typo in one of the dialogues for the Boss Arena's rest hall

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9 Notes!
notes.content:
////FIXES////////////////////////////////////
- Last save file interacted with will now be remembered.
- The state of the Waterfall of Dreams is now save-dependent.

If you run into any issues, please let me know! Thank you for playing.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8 Notes!
notes.content:
[p]////ADDITIONS////////////////////////////////////
- Multiple save files have now been added!

By default, you play on save file 1, so all your current progress should be there! Because this is a volatile change, you may see some weird stuff! If so, please report them to me. I did do testing, but I'm sure there are things that slipped underneath my radar, so please understand.

If you run into any issues, please let me know! Thank you for playing.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7 Notes!
notes.content:
- Crystalline Hive boss no longer softlocks the game if you walk towards the left of the arena.
- Game screen freezes non-player entities when Zooka's badge pop up shows up.

If you run into any issues, please let me know! Thank you for playing.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 Notes!
notes.content:
Changes to make throws more consistent!

////FIXES////////////////////////////////////
- Acro's throw will now always hit the thrown enemy.
- Improved the reliability of Acro's throw for traversal purposes.
- Throwing Big Dummy's eyeball under specific circumstances will no longer crash the game.
- Hemi's throw force now speeds up the longer the entity has being thrown out.

////MISC////////////////////////////////////
- Acro's throw is now a true Izuna Drop, flipping him and his opponent upside down so that he can attempt to crush their neck (it has no effect against the wildlife).

If you run into any issues, please let me know! Thank you for playing.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 Notes!
notes.content:
[p]////ADDITIONS////////////////////////////////////
- Throws now have hitboxes attached during the throw animation, not just at the end! Line up throws to get even more damage out!
- Grabbed entities can now be damaged, but that will force a grab release
- (For new save files) A dialogue-based pop up will show for the first collected non-Zooka badge

////FIXES////////////////////////////////////
- Fixed a rare bug of the game crashing if the Vending Machine enemy somehow gets despawned and destroyed

If you run into any issues, please let me know! Thank you for playing.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 Notes!
notes.content:
Another small change that will make the game ever so slightly less inconvenient.

- Fixed the menu to rewatch the post-final boss cutscene to make it behave consistently like the other menus.

Thank you very much for playing! If there are any other issues you find, please let me know!

notes.content: - You can now choose whether to rewatch the post-final boss fight cutscene again or not if you already beat the final boss.

Small additions that slightly improve the feel of the game.

notes.title: Patch 0.7.2 Notes!
notes.content:
Patch 0.7.2 is out! Last quick patch notes before 0.8.0! Seems like there were a lot of Boss Arena related problems...

////FIXES///////////////////////////////////
- Fixed bug where (most) things were affected by Cheese Physics badge, which broke some interactions (most notably the fireballs from the fire enemy never despawning)
- Fixed being unable to change badges after failing an arena run
- Beating bosses outside of Boss Arena after entering Boss Arena (whether by failing or finishing a run of Boss Arena) would act as if Boss Arena finished
- Impermanent projectiles are less likely to randomly stay on the screen forever 
- Updated Hemi's attack list to accurately match her new jab attacks

////QUALITY OF LIFE///////////////////////////////////
- Star Points now display the * character to better denote the different costs between star badges and regular badges

////ADJUSTMENTS///////////////////////////////////
- Changed Auratoxic Boost from draining 5 aura every second, otherwise take 10 dmg and restore 15% aura, to draining 10 aura every 1.5 seconds otherwise take 15 dmg and restore 21% aura
- Adjusted some badge text to make more sense
- Made Chocoloaf generally easier to deal with
- Buffed Hemi's jab 1 and 2's horizontal range
- Made Hemi's jab 1 more consistently knockback entities based on the direction she faces (entities behind her will still get launched the opposite way)

If you run into any issues, please let me know! Thank you for playing.

notes.title: Patch 0.7.1 Notes!
notes.content:
[p]Patch 0.7.1 is out! This one has requested QoL features, as well as some gameplay adjustments. Take a look below!

////ADDITIONS//////////////////////////////////// [/p][list][*][p]Added randomized Badge Point costs option in Dream Remixer
[/p][/*][/list][p] ////FIXES/////////////////////////////////// [/p][list][*][p]Fixed multi hit moves not being able to hit multiple enemies after the first hit[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where pausing the game as Acro and switching back to Hemi in the same room would despawn all her orbiting stars
[/p][/*][/list][p] ////QUALITY OF LIFE/////////////////////////////////// [/p][list][*][p]Added an unequip all badges button on the badge screen[/p][/*][*][p]Added a save file delete option in the options menu
[/p][/*][/list][p] ////ADJUSTMENTS/////////////////////////////////// [/p][list][*][p]Made Stat Chunk spawn rate increase with higher combo number[/p][/*][*][p]Gave Hemi and Acro different base stats for each stat found in stat chunks, so that each character scales differently with stats[/p][/*][*][p]Made Chocoloaf fall a bit slower and act a bit slower (he got much harder)[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted knockback weight and gravity of Paranimbus and Zurkitera[/p][/*][*][p]Made Hemi's jab slower, but deals more damage, knockback and can be stored like her Up Ground attacks.[/p][/*][/list][p]
I will explain the Hemi jab changes. Long long ago, Hemi's old jab was very similar to her current Up Ground attack. 3 charges, cycles between them each click without pressing it quickly. I changed it to be similar to Acro's jab, where the other jab moves were locked behind pressing the attack button during the current jab's animation, and generally sped up Hemi's jab so that it would feel a little more instant. Turns out, I might have made it too fast, and I wasn't too happy with Hemi's jab being more combo oriented. I missed when each jab was more of their own separate attack, with a lot of knockback attached to it. Using the same animation, I now repurposed Hemi's jab to be slower, but stronger, both damage wise and knockback wise. This might honestly be a net nerf, but I think I owe Hemi back a more distinct jab from Acro's. This new jab of hers will also synergize well with the newly added pushback mechanic, so now Hemi feels more like a juggernaut that pushes enemies around. Asymmetrical balancing is very interesting, so I wanna maintain that. Give each character their distinct traits with unique strengths and weaknesses; otherwise what is the point of having 2 characters here? I might tweak some of the numbers still, but I'm pretty happy with the new direction her (now) current jab is in.

If you run into any issues, please let me know! Thank you for playing.[/p]

notes.title: 0.6.1 Patch Notes!
notes.content:
First update with Early Access!

Firstly, I updated the engine that the game runs on, to fix and be more future proof! This may lead to unforeseen problems, and might not be the wisest thing to release, but now is the best time to update the game engine. 

////FIXES////////////////////////////////////
- Audio now plays at selected audio source!
- Getting hit while armored should no longer disable fast falling
- General text fixes, including a mention of Early Access after finishing all 6 regular stages
- Acro gains his visibility back after Countergale more consistently
- Clipping into terrain happens less frequently
- Grabbing the big red spiky crystals with the armored enemies badge will no longer crash the game
- Added an additional sign in Hemi's challenge room explaining another property of Boomerang Star

////NERFS////////////////////////////////////
- Reduced Stat Chunk's spawn rate from 75% to 50%
- Reduced HP Chunk's stat raise from 5 to 3
- Reduced Aura Chunk's stat raise from 7 to 5

////BUFFS////////////////////////////////////
- Increased Acro's Down Air early air bounce hit considerably (now is roughly his jump height)
- Buffed damage of thrown projectiles across the board by a considerable amount

If you run into any issues, please let me know, either here or the Discord server (preferably the Discord server)! Thank you for playing.
